---
title: "HM #89: Exploring Pittsburgh North Shore"
description: "Half marathon #89 on the Three Rivers Heritage Trail: 14.01 EZ miles at 9:46/mi along the Monongahela, Allegheny, and Ohio."
author: Ben
date: "2026-07-26"
image: "image-19.jpeg"
---

This #LongRunSunday I ran my 89th HM on the Three Rivers Heritage Trail in Pittsburgh! An EZ 14.01mi at 9'46"/mi, EG 413ft with HR 131/143 and VO₂max 54.2. Consumed 2 gels, 8oz electrolyte and 4 salt tablets, ingesting every 4mi. Stopped frequently for photos, also got slightly lost a couple times!

In the past 3 days I officially exhausted the riverside trails at South Side and North Shore westbound — ran them all to the first points of closure. 36.54mi in 4 days, not bad!

Highlight of the run: a large group sitting on a locked down bridge to practice yoga, with a DJ truck blasting some kind of New Age music. I guess they really have too many bridges in Pittsburgh!
